Implemented the repair in src/dotenv/main.py only.

In `set_key`, the quoted branch now escapes backslashes before apostrophes:

```python
if quote:
    value_out = "'{}'".format(
        value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
    )
else:
    value_out = value_to_set
```

This writes `\\` for each literal backslash and `\'` for each apostrophe, both valid single-quote escapes per the documented format. Reading back with `dotenv_values(interpolate=False)` now reproduces the exact value, including consecutive backslashes and backslash-before-quote cases. `quote_mode='never'`, the `auto`/`always` selection logic, and `export` handling are unchanged.
